+title: Watch the inbox folder of each live durable session
+---
+## What
+Add a `DispatchSource` vnode watcher (`.write`) for the `inbox/` folder of each live durable session. Put the watcher type in a new file `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/SessionInboxWatcher.swift`; wire it in `RouterSessionDirectory.swift`.
+
+- Start at `register(_:kind:parentID:requestedByClient:)` (this also covers a restore, because a restored session registers) for a session where `ledgerDirectory(of:)` is not `nil`. Create `inbox/` when it is absent.
+- The first action of the watcher is a scan (`scanInbox(of:)`), because files can arrive while no process owns the session.
+- On each event, scan the full folder. Do not process one file for each event (events merge).
+- Stop at `unregister(_:)` (called from `RoutedSessionActor.close()`) and at `archive`. The event handler hops onto the directory actor.
+- A memory-only session gets no watcher.
+- Only the process that owns the root delivers: the directory of that process is the only one that registers sessions, so no extra lock code is needed. Add a comment that says this.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A file that a test moves into `inbox/` of a live idle session is delivered with no call to `send(_:)`.
+- [ ] A file in `inbox/` before `register` or restore is delivered at start.
+- [ ] A `.tmp` file and a dot file are ignored.
+- [ ] After `close()` and after `archive`, a new file is not delivered and no watcher stays open (no file descriptor leak).
+- [ ] A memory-only session starts no watcher.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Extend `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/RouterSessionDirectoryInboxTests.swift`: live arrival, file before restore, ignored names, stop at close, stop at archive, memory-only.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter RouterSessionDirectoryInboxTests`. Expected: all pass. Run the full suite once at the end (no loops).
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
